entities.name: Alania
entities.description: A legendary otterfolk wizard from Bloomburrow with an insatiable curiosity and a talent for copying magic; travels the Valley seeking to answer "Why?".

entities.name: Rottenmouth Viper
entities.description: Creature Alania faced alone, copying and using its abilities against it.

events.summary: Alania faces a Rottenmouth Viper alone, copying its abilities, and realizes she should have asked "Why not?"
events.quote: she realized she should've been asking "Why not?"
